All 14 queries ran against the input files and gave plausible answers. I checked T12 and T13 by hand and the other answers only by eye, so I haven't verified every one. The first six are the exact queries I ran. In the CSV queries, T12 and T13 are `T12` and `T13` below with the same steps.

T1: `| /data/users | filter ~(/active | eq true) | filter ~(at :email | ne null) | filter ~(/email | lower | endsWith "@example.com") | count`
T2: `| /data/users | filter ~(/roles | map ~(lower) | contains "admin") | sort ~(/name | lower) | map ~(/name)`
T3: `| /data/users | groupBy ~(at :profile | coalesce {} | at :country | coalesce "unknown") | map ~(count)`
T4: `| /data/users | map ~(at :profile | coalesce {} | at :age) | filter ~(ne null) | avg | round 2`
T5: `| filter ~(/state | eq "open") | map ~(/labels | map ~(/name | lower)) | flat | distinct | sort`
T6: `| sort ~([(/comments | desc) /number]) | take 3 | map ~({:number /number :assignee (at :assignee | coalesce {} | at :login)})`
T7: `| filter ~(/state | eq "open") | filter ~(at :assignee | ne null) | groupBy ~(/assignee/login) | map ~(count)`
T8: `| [/dependencies /devDependencies] | reduce {} ~(union) | entries | filter ~(/1 | startsWith "^") | sort ~(/0) | map ~(:e / | /0 | json | drop 1 | take (count | sub 1) | append "@" | append (e | /1))`
T9: `| /services | filter ~(at :enabled | eq true) | filter ~(/port | gt 8000) | map ~(/name | lower) | sort | join ","`
T10: `| lines | filter ~(trim | ne "") | map ~(split " ") | filter ~(/1 | eq "ERROR") | groupBy ~(/2) | map ~(count)`
T11: `| lines | map ~(split " ") | map ~(filter ~(startsWith "ms="))  | filter ~(count | gt 0) | map ~(/0 | drop 3 | parseJson) | avg | round 1`
T12: `| lines | drop 1 | map ~(split ",") | map ~({:c /1 :s (/5 | lower) :p /4 :q /3}) | filter ~(/p | ne "") | map ~({:c /c :s /s :t (:r / | /q | parseJson | mul (r | /p | parseJson))}) | filter ~(/s | eq "shipped") | map ~(/t) | sum | round 2`
T13: `| lines | drop 1 | map ~(split ",") | map ~({:c /1 :s (/5 | lower) :p /4 :q /3}) | filter ~(/p | ne "") | filter ~(/s | ne "cancelled") | map ~({:c /c :t (:r / | /q | parseJson | mul (r | /p | parseJson))}) | groupBy ~(/c) | map ~(map ~(/t) | sum | round 2) | entries | sort ~(/1 | desc) | take 2 | map ~({:customer (/0 | json | drop 1 | take (count | sub 1)) :total /1})`
T14: `["Banana","apple","Cherry","banana","fig","APPLE","date","kiwi","Fig","elderberry"] | map ~(lower) | distinct | sort ~([(count | desc) (/)]) | join "-"`

Two things to know about running these:
- **Input handling:** T10 to T13 read plain text, so I ran them with `--raw`. The `| lines` in T11 has two spaces before `| filter`; that is just a typo in my copy and doesn't change the query.
- **Object keys:** In T3, T7 and T10 the result keys come back as keywords, like `:db`. I left them as they are. T8 and T13 turn keyword keys into strings with `json | drop 1 | take (count | sub 1)`.
